notes: ἐν τῷ + infinitive analysed under rule 61: the preposition takes while and the article is unrepresented.
τοῦ θεοῦ: the ASV writes a bare God, so the article is unrepresented under rules 21 and 23 and of stays with the noun.
Apodotic καί (s015) takes the clause-introducing that; the parallel καί at 5:12 has no English word and is unrepresented, which is the same analysis and not a second one.
